summary: Add optional, unwired sidebar write conversions with exact restored replay and fresh post-folder membership fences.

replay.detail: No production activation or replay change.

schema.detail: Uses existing generated action request types and daemon schemas without new wire fields.

compatibility.detail: The optional client feature converts staged requests into arrangement.edit folder actions or arrangement.membership.edit actions, omitting the creation-only version field. Hosts execute Send(Delivery) with the matching authenticated actor and pass reducer-issued First/Replay provenance unchanged to write_result. Every replay error stays unresolved: refusal of this attempt does not prove an earlier delivery failed. First-delivery allowlisted refusals and explicit applied=none remain definitive. Delivery provenance is not journaled; restored requests conservatively emit Replay. Unknown results persist without automatically sending again; explicit replay or authoritative readback resolves them. Receipts acknowledge but do not prove observation. Compound edits retain completion-persistence and fresh-base barriers. Default dependencies and production wiring are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Existing journal restoration supplies the immutable request used for exact replay.
